title: Hayati Pro Max Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blueberry Cherry Cranberry is a vibrant blend of ripe Blueberries, sweet Cherry and tart Cranberry, offering a layered fruit vape that balances richness with a sharp, tangy edge. The Blueberry delivers smooth, rounded sweetness, while Cherry adds depth and warmth. A sharp burst of Cranberry lifts the mix, giving this trio a bright, punchy finish. Made with nicotine salts for quicker nicotine satisfaction and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures clean flavour delivery and discreet vapour, ideal for everyday use. Part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, this flavour takes inspiration from the brand’s bestselling disposables—now available in 10ml bottles for longer-lasting use and better value, in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
